packageRules.description: ghcr.io/recyclarr/recyclarr publishes each release as `X.Y.Z`, next to floating `X` and `X.Y` tags, `X.Y.Z-dev.N` pre-releases and `edge`. `versioning=semver` on the annotation in defaults/main.yml already keeps the floating tags and pre-releases out, so this is belt-and-braces: it keeps them out even if that annotation is ever changed to `docker` or `loose` versioning.
